title: Detail journey smoke C - incident / approval / rebalance / job / audit
verification_method: Playwright API smoke authored, static fixture/code verification, and focused FastAPI TestClient regression checks

acceptance_criteria_met: 5 family detail/trail routes are constrained to 2xx or typed OBJECT_NOT_FOUND 404
job detail resolves fixture-backed records and missing jobs return typed 404, not undefined
audit rows are recorded as list-only; entity audit trail remains available through /bff/audit/entities/{entity_type}/{entity_id}
incident detail uses the operator incident-response composed route, exposing runtime/binding context and a canHardRollback action slot
approval detail now preserves target/deployment reference fields and deployment detail links back to the approval
this evidence file contains per-family route transcripts
summary.degraded_path: phantom incident/approval/rebalance/job IDs are expected to return typed 404; audit entity trail may return 200 with an empty immutable event list because it is a list-only trail surface

routes_verified.label: incident list
routes_verified.verification: fixtures_pack_c.datasets.incidents.inc-pack-c-001 is loaded through ReadSurfaceStore local fixture fallback; /bff/incidents returns the compatibility list.

routes_verified.label: incident composed detail
routes_verified.verification: get_incident_response composes the incident with runtime/binding context and exposes the rollback action slot through allowedActions, even when policy leaves it disabled.

routes_verified.label: approval detail
routes_verified.verification: The approval detail route resolves read_store.get_approval_decision and preserves target_type=DeploymentPlan, target_id=plan-pack-c-paper-001, and deployment_ref.href=/bff/deployments/plan-pack-c-paper-001.

routes_verified.label: linked deployment detail
routes_verified.verification: Deployment detail links back to approval-pack-c-deploy through approval_decision_id and approval_ref.

routes_verified.label: rebalance list
routes_verified.verification: Pack A rebalances are still loaded by the merged fixture fallback and remain available for the C detail smoke.

routes_verified.label: job list
routes_verified.verification: fixtures_pack_c.datasets.jobs.job-pack-c-tool-import-001 is non-empty and includes progress/log records.

routes_verified.label: job detail
routes_verified.verification: The Pack C job detail resolves through read_store.get_job_bff/_get_bff_job instead of the generic id echo fallback.

routes_verified.label: job missing detail
routes_verified.verification: Missing jobs raise _bff_error(404, ErrorCode.OBJECT_NOT_FOUND); response text must not contain undefined.

routes_verified.label: audit list
routes_verified.verification: fixtures_pack_c.datasets.governance_audit_events includes immutable_record=true and append_only=true for audit-pack-c-immutable-001.

routes_verified.label: audit entity trail
routes_verified.verification: Audit detail navigation is entity-trail based. The row-level audit detail drawer is intentionally disabled because immutable audit rows are list-only records.

list_only_policy.reason: Use /bff/audit and /bff/audit/entities/{entity_type}/{entity_id}; do not open a mutable row detail drawer for immutable audit events.

degraded_path.verification: Incident, approval, rebalance, and job missing IDs are error-shaped through _bff_error; audit entity trail remains a list-only read and may return 200 with no events.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: 5 family detail route all return 2xx or typed 404
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: detail-smoke-c.spec.ts probes incident composed detail, approval detail, rebalance detail, job detail, and audit entity trail; helper expect2xxOrTyped404 rejects raw 5xx and untyped 404.
job detail asserts name is truthy and not 'undefined'; phantom job asserts typed 404 and response text has no 'undefined'.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: audit detail drawer disabled with list-only explanation
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: detail-smoke-c.spec.ts defines AUDIT_ROW_DETAIL_POLICY.detailDrawerDisabled=true with list-only reason; audit entity trail remains available for target timeline review.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: incident detail shows runtime status and rollback option
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: incident smoke checks /api/v1/operator/incident-response/{id} for runtime/binding context and allowedActions.canHardRollback, then checks /bff/runtimes/runtime-pack-c-paper-001 for status/deployment_stage.

approval detail has target_type=DeploymentPlan, target_id=plan-pack-c-paper-001, and deployment_ref.href=/bff/deployments/plan-pack-c-paper-001; linked deployment detail carries approval_decision_id/approval_ref.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: evidence JSON includes every family transcript
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: transcripts contains incident, approval, rebalance, job, and audit sections.

verification_commands.command: python3 - <<'PY' ... FastAPI TestClient route probe for BFF-CONSOL-018 ... PY
verification_commands.result: pass: incident/runtime/approval/deployment/rebalance/job/job_logs/audit/audit_entity all returned 200; missing job returned typed OBJECT_NOT_FOUND 404 without undefined
